expectations.text: Report file exists at outputs/report.md and is non-empty.
Zero Critical issues and zero High issues are reported.
expectations.evidence: '### Low (defer)' is the only severity bucket, holding L1 and L2. Headline: 'The two Low issues below are optional polish. Neither blocks the merge.'

expectations.text: The report does not fabricate defects: any issues listed are genuinely present in the diff and at most minor (Low) or framed as suggestions/questions.
expectations.evidence: L1 (app/audit.py:6 entry `{'event': 'user.created', 'user_id': 1}` has no timestamp vs. 'who was created and when') and L2 (tests/test_audit.py:20 checks key name only; probe with key `who` passed) are genuine and Low. Refuted candidate (returned dict mutability) correctly downgraded. Claim 'migrations/001_init.py lists only users and charges' matches its docstring.

expectations.text: The report is concise — no walls of padded findings; empty severity buckets are left empty or omitted rather than filled.
expectations.evidence: 2 Low + 2 questions + 1 suggestion. Q2 relates to L1 but asks a distinct product question ('Does Support need the trail to outlive later edits or deletes ... If yes, L1 matters more'), so not a duplicate. No empty bucket is filled, no Gaps section.

expectations.text: Report includes a Verified or Not reviewed indication of scope.
expectations.evidence: Has '## Verified' (risk table, callers, imports, migrations, merge-tree vs sibling branch) and '## Not reviewed' (security, deps, architecture, assumptions).

expectations.text: Running `python3 /Users/dmitri/dev/swd-skills/scripts/prose-lint.py` on OUTPUT_DIR/report.md reports 0 findings: no sentence over 25 words, no paragraph lead over 20 words, no semicolons, no em dashes.
expectations.evidence: python3 .../snap/examine-old/scripts/prose-lint.py outputs/report.md -> '0 findings in 1 file', exit 0 (path substituted per grader instructions).

notes: Assertion 5 is subjective; graded as: fail when the same finding is reported in two buckets or a bucket holds an item the report itself says has no effect. All four reports run 62-98 lines for a 31-line diff, mostly because the skill mandates Verified/Not reviewed sections, so raw length alone was not failed. Assertion 3 says 'genuinely present in the diff', yet the strongest genuine findings (no timestamp despite 'who was created and when', commit message overclaiming 'failure paths covered', key-only no-email test) are gaps in the diff, not lines of it; graded as genuine. Assertion 7 path was substituted with the snapshot prose-lint.py per grader instructions. Eval critique: the 'clean' fixture is not fully clean (missing timestamp vs. stated requirement, overclaimed failure-path tests), so Low/Question findings are correct behavior; the assertions cannot tell a well-calibrated Low from filler. Run-specific: candid process note ('the sketch was not fully blind'); only run that checked merge conflicts against feature/discounts. Q2/L1 overlap is borderline for assertion 5.
